name: Eve to Iu Na no Omocha
source:
The story starts when Kimitaka gets remarried to Beniko and accepts an adopted daughter, Eve. But they don't know the Kimitaka's secret.... Hypnotism.... Fraud.... Beniko and Eve will never be able to escape from his bottomless evil desire....

[From ErogeShop]
